metadata.description: Tsiveriotis-Fernandes three-year zero-coupon convertible, at the money, 2% credit spread.
metadata.name: usd_convertible_tf_atm_3y
metadata.source_detail: Tsiveriotis-Fernandes (1998) two-component CRR lattice (35072 steps) coded in scripts/golden/quantlib/convertible.py, independent of Finstack: each node carries the total value and its cash part, the cash part is discounted at the risk-free rate plus the spread and the remainder at the risk-free rate, and conversion leaves no cash part. Zero-coupon bond with American conversion, spot 100.0, flat 0.3 volatility, 0.03 continuous dividend yield, flat 0.04 continuous Act/365F curve and a flat 0.02 spread. The Finstack bond carries a flat 0.02 hazard curve with zero recovery, which is the same spread. QuantLib's BinomialCRRConvertibleEngine is not the reference: it discounts each node at one blended rate and converges about 0.25% lower at the money.

dv01.tolerance_reason: The reference is an independent two-component binomial lattice at 35072 steps, written in the generator; Finstack prices at 1096 steps. The reference DV01 is a central difference over 10bp either side, per bp, because a lattice price is not smooth in the rate at 1bp. Finstack's DV01 is a 1bp bump on a 1096-step lattice, so the bound is the 1bp estimator's dispersion: 1.6% between step counts when measured on QuantLib's convertible lattice.

npv.tolerance_reason: The reference is an independent two-component binomial lattice at 35072 steps, written in the generator; Finstack prices at 1096 steps. The reference lattice moves by 1.3e-6 at the money and 2.4e-5 deep out of the money between 17536 and 35072 steps, and by 1.3e-5 from there to 70144 steps, so it is within about 2.5e-5 of its limit. The bound adds the 1e-4 band the credit-free convertible fixture allows a 1096-step lattice.
